description: This file defines a SessionClient class for managing session-related API interactions, including CRUD operations, blob uploads, and token validation, along with related interfaces and enums.

classes.name: SessionClient
classes.description: Client class providing methods to interact with session-related API endpoints, including CRUD, sharing, forking, deleting, uploading blobs, and token validation.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieve a specific session by ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Create a new session with specified input parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Update an existing session with new data.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Search for sessions matching a search string.

methods.name: share
methods.description: Share a session with a specified shared state.

methods.name: fork
methods.description: Fork a shared session by share ID.

methods.name: uploadBlob
methods.description: Upload a blob to a session using a signed URL.

methods.name: getSignedUploadUrl
methods.description: Obtain a signed URL for uploading a session blob.

methods.name: tokenValid
methods.description: Check if the current token is valid.
